title: Valuative factorization for the Picard pullback locus
statement: Let f : X ⟶ S be flat, proper and locally of finite presentation with geometrically integral fibres, and universally isomorphic structure-sheaf adjunction units. Let E be invertible on X. Let j : Z ⟶ S satisfy the universal factorization equivalence of lem-sc-picard-diagonal-locally-closed (no immersion or finiteness assumption on j). Then each sq : ValuativeCommSq j has a factorization l : Spec(sq.R) ⟶ Z with l ≫ j = sq.i₂.

source.place: More on Morphisms, Tag 0BF0, valuation-ring step using Tag 0EX8

proof.text: Base change f and E to A = sq.R. Flatness, properness, finite presentation and geometric integrality persist. The adjunction-unit hypothesis gives H⁰(X_K,O)=K. The square and the universal factorization equivalence give a finite locally free N over Spec K pulling back to L_K. Nonemptiness of X_K and invertibility of L_K force N to have rank one, so N and L_K are trivial.

The valuation-ring triviality theorem gives a trivialization over Spec sq.R. Taking the finite locally free module O on Spec sq.R in the universal property of j yields the required lift l and its commutativity.
